title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Worksheet: Covered Loan-to-Value Reduction for Long Contract Terms
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Premier 150 worksheet benefit.** The covered loan-to-value percent of the worksheet benefit is reduced by a term reduction. The reduction follows the original term of the Retail Installment Contracts contract the addendum is attached to.

| Contract's original term | Term reduction |
|---|---|
| more than 66 months | 25 points |
| 61 to 66 months | 15 points |
| 60 months or fewer | no reduction |

The reduction is subtracted from the plan's highest covered loan-to-value percent before the covered limit is figured.

**Boundaries:**

- a 67-month term reduces the percent by 25 points;
- a 66-month term reduces it by 15 points;
- a 61-month term also reduces it by 15 points;
- a 60-month term leaves it unreduced.

*Hypothetical case.* On a 72-month contract, a covered percent of 150 falls by 25 points to 125 before the covered limit is figured.
